issues.email_excerpt: We switched on the order confirmation email for your product
issues.explanation: The customer switched it on following support's guidance; 'we' credits the wrong party.

issues.email_excerpt: Our team will change the sender name to your brand name for you.
issues.explanation: Changing the sender name is the customer's own pending step, not ours.
The customer's own step to change the sender name is not conveyed as a customer action.

statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted to find out why your customers were not receiving the order confirmation email after buying.
We switched on the order confirmation email for your product, and you confirmed the email arrived in your inbox after your test order.
The email still shows the default sender name, which can be changed in Email settings under Sender name.
Our team will change the sender name to your brand name for you.
